title: Burns — जलना
warning: For large/deep burns or burns on face/hands/genitals — go to hospital immediately.

steps.instruction: Remove person from heat source. Remove burning clothing unless stuck to skin.
steps.hint: Do not remove clothing stuck to burned skin

steps.instruction: Cool the burn with cool (not cold/ice) running water for 20 minutes.
steps.hint: Ice causes further damage. Cool water only.

steps.instruction: Do NOT apply: butter, toothpaste, oil, or any home remedy to burns.
steps.hint: These trap heat and cause infection

steps.instruction: Cover loosely with clean cling film or non-fluffy cloth. Do not wrap tightly.
steps.hint: Covering prevents infection and reduces pain

steps.instruction: For chemical burns: Brush off dry chemical first, then rinse with lots of water for 20 minutes.
For small mild burns: Keep cool, cover, watch for signs of infection.
steps.hint: Signs of infection: increasing pain, redness spreading, pus, fever

steps.instruction: Seek hospital care for: burns larger than palm, burns on face/hands/feet, all electrical burns.
